description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed on all horizontal table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge
of the parent table (all horizontal borders which are not the topmost or bottommost borders).

params.description: The horizontal table cell border style.
params.name: sType

params.description: The width of the current border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: nSize

params.description: The spacing offset in the horizontal table cells of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: nSpace

signature: SetTableBorderInsideH(sType: BorderType, nSize: pt_8, nSpace: pt, r: number, g: number, b: number): boolean
